name: Amari Tsuyo
source:
A Biology teacher at Song of Angels high. She frequently picks on Akemi, her jealousy of her popularity manifesting. She held her back to waste her time needlessly on the day of the outbreak, causing them to be stuck together.
She is completely oblivious to her narcissism.

Favorite Color: Plum
Blood Type: A-
